system.description:
This skill targets a willing character. You may make a [Normal Move] up to your [Speed] Sq. The target simultaneously makes a [Safe Move] to the same square you end your movement in.

(Minor): Increase the distance moved by +1 Sq. 
(Target: Extra): The use of this skill doesn't count towards your Limit.

A skill that allows you to keep pace with your companions and move at the same time. For warriors, it is an important rule to never leave the object to protect.
